proof_text:
have h_main : lastDigit_postcond n (lastDigit n h_precond) h_precond := by
    have h₁ : lastDigit n h_precond = n % 10 := rfl
    rw [h₁]
    constructor
    · -- Prove 0 ≤ n % 10 < 10
      have h₂ : n % 10 < 10 := by
        omega
      have h₃ : 0 ≤ n % 10 := by
        omega
      exact ⟨h₃, h₂⟩
    · -- Prove the rest of the conditions
      constructor
      · -- Prove n % 10 - (n % 10) = 0
        have h₄ : n % 10 - n % 10 = 0 := by
          omega
        exact h₄
      · -- Prove (n % 10) - n % 10 = 0
        have h₅ : (n % 10 : ℕ) - n % 10 = 0 := by
          omega
        exact h₅
  exact h_main
